ideation.instructions: Generate falsifiable, mechanism-distinct hypotheses. Separate observation, literature and inference.

literature.instructions: Record exact locators, source type, support, contradiction, retrieval limits and novelty uncertainty.

experiment.instructions: Execute the frozen protocol, preserve raw evidence and keep proposed methods distinct from completed experiments.

analysis.instructions: Classify each claim correctly and cite only evidence IDs allowed for that claim type.

review.instructions: Reject unsupported empirical classification, missing source-to-claim mappings, hidden failures and overclaims.
